hypotheses.R1_stratified_sketch_is_stable: Independent tail estimates with exact top-16 quadrature have median impact correlation at least 0.90 and top-16 recall at least 0.75 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R2_fisher_modes_pass_matched_finite_cont: Fisher-top modes have at least twice the median exact KL of local-amplitude-matched controls and win at least 75% of pairs on both corpora.
hypotheses.R3_fisher_set_has_larger_combined_effect: The matched-norm Fisher route has at least 1.25 times the local oracle's median native KL on both corpora.
hypotheses.R4_individual_importance_cancels_in_comb: R2 passes while the Fisher route has at most half the local oracle's median KL on both corpora.
hypotheses.R5_local_and_fisher_supports_differ: Median support overlap of the two top-16 sets is at most 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R6_hierarchy_targets_local_computation: The hierarchical route has higher finite-effect fidelity to the local oracle than to the Fisher oracle on both corpora.
